title: DIY feedback digest + sprint handoff
summary: Quick, pragmatic synthesis of recent customer threads (mid-Oct -> Nov 2029). Focused on small probes we can run in next sprint + who owns the follow-ups. Not a full roadmap doc — this is a handoff packet for eng and product to pick fast wins.
content:
Context and scope:
- Pull window: 2029-10-15 -> 2029-11-10. Sources: support tickets (tier2), recorded calls, pilot feedback from three Dedicated customers, Slack mentions, and the feedback collection page (lightweight survey).
- Goal: distill into 1) top friction themes, 2) quick probes (<=2w) with approx effort, 3) signal-to-roadmap flags.

Raw themes (ranked by frequency, then severity):
1) Model-variant fallback confusion (30 signals)
   - Customers report unpredictable fallbacks when a model variant is out of capacity; logs show 'variant-automatic-fallback' but UI/SDK gives opaque error.
   - Quote: "We got a 500 and then a different model answered — we didn't know whether quality changed."
2) Token-cost attribution mismatch (21 signals)
   - Billing shows token counts not aligned with console traces; customers doing cost analysis can't match SDK calls to billing rows.
   - Several customers running batching experiments reported spikes in billed tokens after enabling prefix caching.
3) Private deployment onboarding friction (14 signals)
   - VPN/KMS steps unclear; deployment docs assume corporate firewall patterns that don't hold for some banks.
4) Observability gaps at the request level (12 signals)
   - Need lightweight trace IDs surfaced back to SDK/console to link an app request to infra traces.
5) Embeddings latency variance (9 signals)
   - Spikes when concurrent small batches hit model cold-shards; mostly on dedicated clusters during backups.

Quick probes (prioritized for next sprint):
A) "Fallback transparency" patch (owner: Priya, eng: ENG-6389) — 1 week
   - UX: return an explicit header/field in streaming/chunked responses: fallback.model_variant and fallback.reason (capacity|timeout|incompatible).
   - Low-risk server change + SDK surface update.
   - Customer value: reduces support churn and escalations; short-term ETA ~1 week to server + SDK patch.
   - Metrics to watch: decrease in "unknown model" escalations; support ticket re-open rate per account.

B) "Billing reconcile tool" (owner: Diego) — 2 weeks (MVP)
   - Lightweight script that crosswalks SDK request ids to billing rows using timestamp windows and token heuristics; delivered as a colab + sample dataset.
   - Rationale: immediate relief for finance teams doing cost attribution.

C) "Private onboarding checklist + firewall patterns" (owner: Liam) — 3 days to draft, follow-up workshop with two bank pilots
   - Create a vendor-agnostic checklist (KMS endpoints, NAT rules, allowed egress IPs) and a checklist PDF.

D) "Trace ID passthrough" experiment (owner: Aisha, eng: ENG-6421) — 2 weeks experiment
   - Add optional request_id header that is echoed into console traces, request logs, and can be returned in errors.
   - Add console filter to search traces by request_id.

E) "Embeddings burst guard" config (owner: Priya + infra) — 2 weeks
   - Temporarily throttle concurrent small-batch embedding jobs on a per-customer basis or inject jitter to reduce shard hot spots.

Impact estimates (back-of-envelope):
- Fallback transparency: medium engineering cost (2 devs part-time) with immediate support load reduction potential (est. 20% fewer follow-ups on variant confusion).
- Billing reconcile tool: low cost, high perceived value to finance teams; could reduce churn risk for 2 pilot customers.
- Private onboarding checklist: trivial effort, high ROI for regulated customers.
- Trace ID passthrough: moderate infra + console work, high investigability payoff for SRE and large customers.
- Embeddings guard: moderate infra tuning, prevents repeated latency incidents.

Open questions / Risks:
- Can we safely expose fallback.variant in all contexts (privacy/model fingerprinting concerns)? Need legal sign-off if model metadata is customer-sensitive.
- Billing reconcile heuristic will be imperfect; must be explicit that it's a support tool not a billing authority.
- Trace ID passthrough might increase log volume (cost); consider sampling or 30d retention limit.

Customer vignettes (short):
- BankPilot A: saw fallback when scaling spikes at month-end payroll batch. Escalation happened with their finance ops because token spend jumped unexpectedly. Wants both billing clarity and fallback transparency.
- RetailAI: embedding variance for search re-ranking causing inconsistent user experience during Black Friday testing window. Concerned about SLAs.
- StartupX (Dedicated): confused about when the private control plane requires additional firewall open ports; they'd like a "checklist runbook" and a pairing session.

Immediate next steps (handoff to product + eng):
- Priya: scope server change + SDK surfacing for fallback transparency; create a one-pager by EOD Nov 14.
- Diego: assemble dataset and run heuristic mapping for billing reconcile demo; schedule a 30-min demo with Finance contact at BankPilot A.
- Liam: draft private onboarding checklist and book a 60-min pairing with StartupX engineering.
- Aisha: create an observability spike plan for trace_id passthrough; coordinate with SRE for retention policy.

Slack and tickets to reference (searchable):
- #cs-product-feedback Nov thread: "fallbacks and billing spikes" (link pinned)
- Ticket CS-1724: BankPilot A escalation (internal)
- Ticket CS-1692: RetailAI embedding latency trace

Unresolved items to push to next sprint planning:
- Full billing alignment roadmap (requires billing team, finance, and product)
- Investigate long-term embedding placement strategies (shard-aware routing)

Notes to self / rough timeline for sprint planning:
- Week 1: fallback transparency + private onboarding checklist + billing demo prep
- Week 2: trace-id experiment + embeddings guard prototype

Random quick wins (if anyone has spare cycles):
- Add a short FAQ in support portal about "What happens when a model variant is unavailable?" (1-2hrs)
- Create a small sample notebook showing token-count differences with and without prefix caching (3-4 hrs)

End of packet.
action_items: Priya: one-pager for fallback transparency by 2029-11-14
Diego: billing demo dataset + colab by 2029-11-18
Liam: private onboarding checklist draft by 2029-11-15
Aisha: coordinate trace-id spike and SRE retention policy by 2029-11-20
Support: add fallback FAQ to portal (owner: Support lead)
decision_points: Expose fallback.model_variant in API responses? (Legal review required)
Treat billing reconcile script as advisory vs authoritative
Retention window for trace_id logs (30 days suggested vs 7 days)
impact_estimates: Fallback transparency: ~20% reduction in variant-related support escalations
Billing reconcile tool: reduces finance investigation time by ~40% for pilot accounts
Private checklist: reduces onboarding time for private deployments by ~2-3 days
